key_highlights: RBA executes a 15-year-high rate hike to combat sticky 'home-grown' inflation, triggering downward pressure on the ASX.
Australian Dollar (AUD) hammered into the 60-cent range following the rate decision and broader global economic uncertainty.
Significant stress emerges in the property market with accelerating house price falls and widespread mortgage holder distress.
Global tech sector faces immense volatility as Wall Street swings from greed to fear over the staggering $4.3 trillion hidden costs and existential risks of AI.
Domestic mining and materials see bright spots with local junior explorers unveiling major copper, manganese, and tin-tungsten discoveries.

sectors.trend: Bearish pressure due to mounting mortgage stress and credit risk.
sectors.implications: While higher rates typically boost Net Interest Margins (NIM), the sheer magnitude of household distress threatens to spike bad debt provisions for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX).

sectors.trend: Mixed to Positive; strong critical mineral exploration contrasting with gold liquidation.
sectors.implications: A weaker AUD heavily benefits USD-earning major miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX). Meanwhile, junior explorers are presenting high-beta opportunities with successful local drilling programs.

sectors.trend: Highly Bearish; property market described as hitting a 'tipping point'.
sectors.implications: REITs will face severe valuation headwinds as capitalization rates expand. Residential property developers and aligned sectors face an imminent bust, notably in SEQ.

sectors.trend: Volatile; local infrastructure investment offset by global AI contagion risks.
sectors.implications: Despite local bright spots like a $15b data center, Australian tech stocks are highly vulnerable to Wall Street sell-offs driven by existential and economic fears regarding AI.

key_themes: Aggressive monetary tightening and sticky inflation
Property market correction and consumer stress
Global AI exuberance colliding with systemic risk realities

risk_assessment.mitigation: Pivot portfolio towards defensive consumer staples (WOW.AX, COL.AX) and companies with strong pricing power that are immune to discretionary spending drops.
Underweight or short domestic residential REITs, building materials (BLD.AX), and major mortgage-exposed retail banks.
Avoid high-multiple growth stocks. Rotate capital into tangible, cash-generating assets like infrastructure and established resource producers.
Maintain diversified resource exposure. Hedge gold positions given liquidation warnings, but watch for oil supply shocks from Japan policy shifts and US-Iran impasses.

opportunities.rationale: The Australian Dollar hammering into the 60s provides an immediate, unhedged margin expansion for top-tier commodity producers and global healthcare leaders.
High-grade local discoveries in copper, manganese, and polymetallics offer massive upside as the global energy transition demands non-Chinese supply chains.

defensive_moves.rationale: The combination of 15-year-high interest rates, a housing bust, and collapsing household budgets means discretionary retail spending will crater.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Residential Property and Mortgages
defensive_moves.rationale: A tipping point in the housing market, particularly in SEQ, combined with maxed-out mortgage holders poses systemic valuation and credit risks.

market_outlook.short_term: The ASX is set for a turbulent 1-3 months. RBA rate hikes, sticky domestic inflation, and a weakened AUD are creating significant headwinds. Expect defensive posturing and a rotation out of rate-sensitive sectors like tech and real estate.
market_outlook.long_term: Over the 6-12 month horizon, the critical question is whether the RBA's aggressive stance triggers a deep recession or successfully quells inflation. A potential pivot in late 2026/early 2027 could spark a sharp recovery, but until then, capital preservation via defensive staples and USD-earning commodities is paramount.
key_catalysts: Wall Street earnings reports from mega-cap tech and AI infrastructure providers
CoreLogic monthly dwelling values (watching the pace of SEQ price falls)
Global oil supply disruptions or agreements (US-Iran dynamics)
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate breaking lower thresholds
Major bank bad debt provisions in upcoming reporting seasons
Spot prices for Iron Ore, Copper, and Gold
Yield spread between Australian 3-year and 10-year government bonds
